title: Ownership of the Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: When the truth of the ancient Heavenly Realm's collapse first surfaced, Chen Ji realized—the Tianji Record in his hands was merely a discarded piece in a much larger chess game.

text.content:
That face.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his knuckles turning white. It was a face he believed had long been buried in the depths of memory—angular features, a faint old scar between his brows, the same scar left when he, as a child, witnessed his father being hunted by the sect. Eight years. He thought that person had died in that catastrophe long ago.

"Father..." The word escaped from his lips, and Chen Ji himself was stunned. He never showed weakness in front of others, yet now, something in his chest was violently trembling. Mo Xiansheng, or rather Chen Xuan, his once closest kin, now floated before him in spirit form, with an expression in his eyes that Chen Ji had never seen before.

Mo Xiansheng's spirit flickered slightly, and a bitter smile appeared on his aged face.

"You've grown, Ji'er." His voice was no longer the profound and mysterious tone of everyday, but carried the richness and vicissitudes of aged wine, "Over these eight years, I've watched you grow from a naive child to who you are today. Every price you paid when using the Tianji Record, every calculation you made while scheming across the world—father saw it all."

Chen Ji remained silent. He simply stood there, chest heaving, while his fingertips secretly gathered a wisp of spiritual energy within his sleeve. He was waiting—for this "father" to give him a reason sufficient to explain eight years of deception.

dialogue.content: "That pursuit eight years ago was a scheme set up by your father himself." Mo Xiansheng's spirit spoke slowly, each word seeming to be squeezed out from between his teeth, "Only by making you believe the entire Chen family was annihilated could you completely sever your attachment to the Tianqing Sect, truly infiltrating their ranks in the guise of waste. The inheritor of the Tianji Record cannot have any weaknesses."

text.content:
Sever all attachments.

Chen Ji let out a low laugh, from which no emotion could be discerned. He thought of himself at seven, hiding in the ruins watching "father's" body being carried away; of himself at fourteen, being stepped on by others in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters, only able to bite his lip hard; and more importantly, of every time he used the Tianji Record to foresee the future, that soul-tearing pain after his Heavenly Fate Value depleted.

"So my weakness was severed by your own hands?" He raised his head, dark currents swirling in the depths of his eyes, "How truly devoted you were."

dialogue.content: "You don't understand." Mo Xiansheng's spirit suddenly pressed closer, the oppressive might toppling like mountain ranges, "The one chosen by the Tianji Record is never the controller, but the vessel. You think you're scheming across the world? No—it is the Tianji Record scheming through your hands! Every inheritor through the ages—including your father—was merely a piece on its chessboard!"

text.content:
At that moment, the Heavenly Eye that had lain dormant in Chen Ji's brow center suddenly trembled.

A blinding golden light erupted from his forehead, and in the depths of his pupils emerged an endless vortex. This was the Heavenly Eye—that mysterious remnant of the ancient Heavenly Realm, now hungrily devouring the spiritual energy within his body.

"Not good!" Mo Xiansheng's face changed drastically, his spirit lunging toward Chen Ji, "It's awakening ahead of schedule!"

Chen Ji felt his head splitting apart, as if something was tearing through his Mental Sea. The Heavenly Eye's consciousness flooded in like a tide—not a gentle merger, but a brutal encroachment.

He saw—

A collapsing heavens, countless immortals falling, and a pair of giant eyes spanning heaven and earth. Those eyes had no pupils, only a void of whiteness, yet they made him tremble from the depths of his soul.

"The Heavenly Realm... collapsed..." Fragmented images flickered through his mind, each piece carrying the desolation and despair of antiquity.

"Chen Ji."

A temperatureless voice rang in his mind, directly bypassing his consciousness barriers. Chen Ji's hair stood on end—all the defenses he had laid in his Mental Sea were completely useless at this moment.

"I've finally waited for you." That voice was ancient and majestic, as if coming from the primordial chaos, "A thousand years. For a full thousand years, this seat has finally awaited a perfect vessel."

dialogue.content: "Vessel?" Chen Ji gritted his teeth, constructing a mental defense within his Mental Sea, "What exactly are you? Was the Heavenly Eye not your scheme? Are you not the Ultimate Chess Player?"

text.content:
That voice let out a low laugh, filled with endless arrogance and disdain.

"The Ultimate Chess Player?" It seemed to have heard something laughable, "Those ants thought they were playing a grand game, not knowing they haven't even seen this seat's face. The Tianji Record is a fragment scattered before this seat's fall, and the Heavenly Eye was transformed from this seat's half-trace of soul. We were originally one."

dialogue.content: "This seat was once the sovereign of the ancient Heavenly Realm." The Heavenly Eye consciousness continued, voice carrying nostalgia, "A thousand years ago, the Heavenly Realm encountered a great calamity and collapsed. This seat fled into the cycle of reincarnation in soul form, waiting for the opportunity to reshape the Heavenly Realm's order. Now, with both the Tianji Record and Heavenly Eye within you, you are the best candidate for this seat's revival."

text.content:
Chen Ji's Mental Sea convulsed violently. He finally understood—every scheme, every calculation, was merely a joke before a true ancient great being.

He thought of Ling Yuan, the old sect master he considered the greatest threat; of Han Lie, the enemy with逆天 combat power; even of the Ultimate Chess Player, the existence he thought controlled everything. So on the true chessboard, they were all pieces.

And he, Chen Ji, was merely a vessel about to be devoured.

Mo Xiansheng's spirit madly struck at the Heavenly Eye consciousness within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, attempting to separate the two.

"Ji'er, hold fast to your original mind!" His voice was anxious and hoarse, "Once the Heavenly Eye fully awakens, your consciousness will be completely overwritten! Father used eight years to build this scheme precisely so your soul would be strong enough to resist it!"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye consciousness is eroding your Mental Sea, and Mo Xiansheng's spirit is attempting to intervene. At this critical moment, you must make a choice:

choices.text: Actively merge with the Heavenly Eye consciousness
choices.description: Use the power of the Tianji Record to reversely devour the Heavenly Eye consciousness, turning this ancient remnant soul into your own use. The risk is extremely high, but upon success you will obtain true Heavenly Realm power.
choices.visible_reward: Gain partial power of the Heavenly Realm Sovereign
choices.risk_hint: Once failed, you will disappear completely

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly released his Mental Sea defenses, meeting the Heavenly Eye consciousness with a near-mad posture. "You want a vessel?" He coldly laughed in his heart, "Then let's see who devours whom!" The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently within him, countless ancient runes surging from the depths of his Mental Sea, colliding intensely with the Heavenly Eye consciousness.

choices.text: Join forces with Mo Xiansheng to resist
choices.description: Accept Mo Xiansheng's spirit power, utilizing the backup手段 left by your father's eight-year scheme to confront the Heavenly Eye consciousness head-on. This is a stable path but may miss a great opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily Suppress the Heavenly Eye Consciousness
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye May Awaken Again in the Future

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fiercely poured into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, merging with his own consciousness. A familiar yet alien power exploded within Chen Ji's body—that was the inheritance dormant in the Chen family's bloodline. 'Ji'er, your father will protect you one last time.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried determination, and the remnant soul began to burn violently.

choices.text: Draw Out and Expel the Heavenly Eye Consciousness
choices.description: Use oneself as bait to draw out the Heavenly Eye consciousness from the Mental Sea, utilizing the ancient forbidden seal within the Tianji Record to temporarily lock it away. This requires enduring the agony of soul-tearing.
choices.visible_cost: Soul Sustains Damage, Heavenly Fate Value Significantly Depletes
choices.risk_hint: May Enrage the Heavenly Eye Consciousness

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, opening his Mental Sea completely in a near self-destructive manner. The Heavenly Eye consciousness surged out greedily, but upon touching Chen Ji's soul core, it was死死锁住 by an ancient forbidden seal. 'A mere remnant soul dares to devour this seat?' Chen Ji sneered coldly, blood seeping from the corner of his eye, 'Let me show you what true scheming means.'

Three consciousnesses clash violently within the Mental Sea.

The Heavenly Eye consciousness is like an ancient beast, fierce and greedy; Chen Ji's will is like a tempered blade, cold and precise; while Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul acts as a barrier, separating the two while constantly depleting itself.

'Tripartite game...' Chen Ji caught a thread of clarity in the chaos, 'So this is the true chess game.'

Just then, the Heavenly Eye consciousness suddenly let out an astonished roar.

'This aura... how can there be a third force within you?!'

Chen Ji's heart stirred. He felt it—there was indeed a consciousness hidden in the deepest part of his Mental Sea, one he had never detected. That consciousness was faint to the point of being almost negligible, yet at this moment, it resonated with the Heavenly Eye consciousness.

Could it be... the aura of the ultimate chess player?

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" For the first time, the Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice carried terror, "How could those ants渗透到这里... unless—" It abruptly stopped, then let out an angry shriek, "Chen Xuan! It's you! You brought them here!"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a desolate laugh.

"Heavenly Eye, did you think your father spent these eight years merely setting up Chen Ji's path to strength?" His voice grew weaker, yet carried the desperation of breaking all bridges, "I knew of your existence long ago. Rather than letting Ji'er face you alone, I would rather... show him the true chess game!"

The remnant soul exploded violently, countless light specks scattered like stars across Chen Ji's Mental Sea, each point of light a scene—unveiling the truth of the Heavenly Realm's collapse, the inside story of ancient great powers' fall, and an earth-shaking conspiracy spanning ten thousand years.

As the light specks flooded into the Mental Sea, Chen Ji saw.

The ancient Heavenly Realm did not collapse due to the Great Catastrophe, but was overthrown by internal forces working together. The Heavenly Eye—this former sovereign—was betrayed, sealed, and had its divine power divided by its own offspring. The Tianji Record, the Heavenly Eye, and that as-yet unrevealed ultimate chess player were all products of that betrayal.

"So that's it." Chen Ji closed his eyes, a cold smile curling his lips, "The so-called Heavenly Will is nothing but the obsession of a loser."

dialogue.content: "Ant!" The Heavenly Eye consciousness raged, "What do you know! This seat is the legitimate one! I shall reshape the order of the Heavenly Realm, returning all to its proper course! And you are merely a vessel to承载 this seat's return!"

text.content:
Chen Ji opened his eyes abruptly.

At this moment, within his Mental Sea, the Heavenly Eye consciousness, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, and the hidden power left by the ultimate chess player formed a delicate tripod of forces. And he himself stood at the center of these three powers.

"Reshape the order of the Heavenly Realm?" He laughed softly, a laugh devoid of fear, containing only cold calculation, "You can't even deal with your own son, yet speak of order?"

dialogue.content: "What did you say?!" The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice suddenly turned sharp.

text.content:
Chen Ji reached out, and a crystalline point of light appeared in his palm—that was the final gift Mo Xiansheng left before dispersing. In the scene, a young god was confronting the Heavenly Eye, bearing seven-tenths resemblance to the Heavenly Eye.

"Your own offspring, personally sealed you." Chen Ji spoke each word deliberately, "And that ultimate chess player is his legacy. He began his scheme ten thousand years ago to completely annihilate your remnant soul. The Tianji Record choosing me was merely a trap set for you."

The Heavenly Eye consciousness fell into momentary silence.

Chen Ji felt the force eroding his Mental Sea weakening, but he knew this was merely the calm before the storm. The Heavenly Eye's dignity would not allow it to accept this fact, yet the memory of being betrayed by its offspring ten thousand years ago clearly touched its deepest wound.

"You wish to利用我?" The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice returned, but now carried a dangerous undertone, "Do you think knowing the truth allows you to turn the tables? Chen Ji, you are too naive. A scheme spanning ten thousand years—how could a mere mortal comprehend it?"

choice.prompt: The consciousnesses of three factions are wrestling within your Mental Sea. The Heavenly Eye consciousness is enraged yet still coveting your body, the ultimate chess player's power lurks in the shadows, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul has been exhausted. At this critical moment, you must make a decision:

choices.text: Form a Deal with the Heavenly Eye
choices.description: Utilize the Heavenly Eye's hatred of the ultimate chess player to propose temporary cooperation—first eliminate that force which betrayed it ten thousand years ago. You will gain part of the Heavenly Eye's power, but the price is you must help it reshape the order of the Heavenly Realm in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Bind with the Ancient Evil Thought
choices.visible_reward: Gain Part of the Heavenly Eye's Power and Knowledge
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye May Seek Possession During Cooperation

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Heavenly Eye consciousness fell silent for a moment before letting out a low laugh. "You're far more interesting than those hypocritical immortals. Cooperation? Very well, this One shall see what tricks you're capable of." A torrential power began to surge into Chen Ji's meridians, bones resonating along the way, flesh screaming in agonizing reconstruction.

choices.text: Activate the Ultimate Chess Master's Power
choices.description: Since the Ultimate Chess Master has also left a trump card in your Mental Sea, why not take the initiative to awaken this power and let the two ancient existences destroy each other? You would reap the benefits, but it might also reveal the Ultimate Chess Master's true colors.
choices.visible_reward: May Simultaneously Weaken Both Ancient Powers
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chess Master May Be Harder to Deal With Than the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and the dormant power in the depths of his Mental Sea was violently activated by his will. A cold aura rushed out from the deepest part of his soul, colliding head-on with the Heavenly Eye consciousness. "How dare a mere ant!" While the Heavenly Eye raged, an unfamiliar voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind—the Ultimate Chess Master's hidden piece had finally revealed its true form.

choices.text: Use One's Body as a Furnace for Refining
choices.description: Do not follow either side's path; instead, refine all three consciousnesses in your own Mental Sea furnace. What you seek is not cooperation, not exploitation, but forcibly merging three ancient powers with a mortal body—this is a path no one has ever walked.
choices.visible_cost: Endure Soul Agony Beyond All Limits
choices.visible_reward: May Create an Entirely New Power System
choices.risk_hint: Success Rate Extremely Low; Failure Means Soul Annihilation

text.content: A manic light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. He spread his arms wide, allowing three distinctly different consciousnesses to pour into his Mental Sea. Tearing, burning, reshaping—the soul hovered at the edge of limits, blood mist spraying from his mouth crystallizing into eerie runes in the air. "Come at me!" he roared to the heavens, "Chen Ji has never been anyone's chess piece!"

Just as the three consciousnesses were locked in a stalemate, an eerie fluctuation emerged from Chen Ji's Brow Center.

It was neither the aura of the Heavenly Eye nor the hidden hand of the Ultimate Chess Master, nor Mo Xiansheng's lingering warmth. It was a power extremely familiar yet impossibly appearing here—carrying the unique mark of the Chen family bloodline, yet containing some诡异 fluctuation he had never witnessed.

"This is..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

A blurry image flashed through his mind—a scene he had never seen: a young girl his age, imprisoned in chains within an abyss, surrounded by eerie formations. The girl's features bore a resemblance to him, but her eyes held a touch more innocence and stubbornness.

Chen Nian.

This name exploded in Chen Ji's mind like thunder. His younger sister, the relative taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"—why would she be sending information to his Mental Sea at this moment?

"Interesting." The Heavenly Eye consciousness suddenly turned playful. "It seems your sister is more valuable than this One imagined. Heavenly Fate Lock Key, one in ten thousand ages—she is actually one of the keys to unsealing this One. No wonder the Ultimate Chess Master went to such lengths to conceal her."

Chen Ji's killing intent surged violently.

He could accept being reduced to a chess piece, could accept being devoured by the Heavenly Eye, could accept ten thousand years of conspiracies and schemes—but he would never accept anyone exploiting his sister. Even if that person was his biological father he had never met, even if that power came from ancient taboos ten thousand years ago.

"Where is Chen Nian?" His voice was ice-cold without a trace of warmth. "Speak."

dialogue.content: "Want to know?" The Heavenly Eye consciousness let out a shrill laugh. "Then cooperate乖乖 with this One. When this One reshapes the celestial order, your sister will naturally become a distinguished guest. Otherwise..." It didn't finish, but the bare-faced threat was self-evident.

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes.

In the Mental Sea, the Heavenly Eye consciousness roared, the Ultimate Chess Master's power lay dormant, and the faint fluctuation from Chen Nian was like a lighthouse, guiding him through the darkness. The three ancient powers thought he was hesitating, unaware he was rapidly calculating everything.

"Cooperation?" He suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of playfulness. "Senior Heavenly Eye, you seem to have forgotten one thing."

"What thing?" The Heavenly Eye consciousness asked warily.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, the ancient Heavenly Eye mark reflected in his pupils, and a cold smirk curved his lips—his signature expression. "Chen Ji never makes a losing deal. You want to use my body for rebirth, surely you must offer some诚意?"

dialogue.content: "What do you want?" The Heavenly Eye consciousness's voice dropped.

text.content:
Chen Ji raised one finger.

"First, my sister's location."

A second finger rose.

"Second, the Ultimate Chess Master's true identity."

A third finger.

"Third—" his gaze turned sharp, "I want thirty percent of your ten thousand years of accumulated celestial knowledge."

dialogue.content: "Presumptuous!" The Heavenly Eye consciousness roared, tempestuous waves rising in the Mental Sea. "A mere mortal dares negotiate terms with this One?!"

text.content:
Chen Ji stood motionless, allowing that pressure to roll over him.

"You can certainly take possession now." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "But I dare guarantee, before my consciousness completely dissipates, I will detonate all the Tianji Record runes in my Mental Sea. At that time, even your remnant soul won't escape alive."

He paused, the curve of his lips deepening. "Senior has been laying plans for ten thousand years—surely you don't want to fail at this critical moment?"

The Mental Sea fell into deathly silence.

The Heavenly Eye consciousness was clearly weighing the pros and cons. Chen Ji could sense that the originally ferocious erosion force was weakening, replaced by a kind of scrutiny and calculation.

After a long while, that ancient voice rang out again, carrying a meaningful smile. "Well said, Chen Ji. No wonder the Tianji Record chose you."

A torrent of information rushed into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—that was the intelligence the Heavenly Eye transmitted.

Chen Nian is imprisoned in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, where an ancient seal left ten thousand years ago still remains. The identity of the Ultimate Chessmaster is more horrifying than Chen Ji could have imagined—

"He is the reincarnation of the Heaven's Eye Son." The voice of the Heaven's Eye consciousness carried complex emotions. "Ten thousand years ago, it was his bloodline that betrayed me. Now, he seeks to completely erase all traces of my existence—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key in your sister's possession is merely the key he will use to unseal the formation."

dialogue.content: "So..." A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, "The Ultimate Chessmaster does not intend to harness the Tianji Record—but to utterly destroy it."

text.content:
"Clever." The Heaven's Eye consciousness snorted coldly. "What you perceived as a grand stroke of fortune was nothing more than bait he laid out. The moment the Tianji Record becomes complete is the moment I resurrect—and that is precisely what he has been waiting for, to erase both me and my inheritor in one stroke. Your sister is the final piece he needs to shatter the seal."

Chen Ji drew a deep breath.

All the clues connected at this moment: the Ultimate Chessmaster's ten-thousand-year scheme, the Holy Sect's covetous designs on Chen Nian, the deep connection between the Tianji Record and the Heaven's Eye—turns out from the very beginning, he had only been a pawn, used to draw out the Heaven's Eye only to be eliminated alongside it.

"Interesting." Chen Ji laughed softly, the sound carrying no anger, only cold excitement. "It seems this game is far grander than I imagined."

He raised his head, his gaze piercing through the Mental Sea as if seeing his imprisoned sister ten thousand miles away.

Chen Nian, wait for your brother.

This time, he is no longer playing alone. He has Su Qingyao's protection by his side, Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist, and the intelligence Mo Xiansheng traded his life for. And his enemies—whether the Heaven's Eye, the Ultimate Chessmaster, or that unfathomable old Sect Master Ling Yuan—will all come to understand one thing.

Chen Ji is never a piece to be manipulated.

He is the Chess Player.
